name: OS 1.63 (stock)
about: Elektron's final OS for the SPS-1UW. It has no boot hook: the reset code jumps straight to the OS, so there is nothing to chain the patcher's boot routine onto. The patcher converts it once into the prepared 1.63 base (stock-163-prepared.json, made by engine/src/prepare.ts) and patches that instead. The web page does this automatically.
refuse: use the prepared 1.63 base: stock 1.63 has no boot hook. Make it once with `node engine/dist/src/cli.js --prepare-163 --in <stock 1.63 .bin or .syx> --out os163-prepared.syx` and patch that (docs/BASES.md).

qualification.by: Stock OS; patched through the prepared 1.63 base
